segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for jumping on, Dana. I wanted to clean up the implementation note before Friday. I saw your email about the sandbox import and the training date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Right. Your implementation coordinator told my ops lead yesterday that the historical sandbox import was not in scope and would be a separate $1,800 services line. That was a surprise, because you and I agreed on the March 12 call it was included if we signed by March 29.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: You’re right, and I owe you an apology. I checked the CRM notes and the signed order form has the 85 seats, the $42,500 annual subscription, and the two admin trainings, but I did not put the sandbox import into the internal handoff for services. So they had no visibility to what we agreed, and they quoted it like a new request. That gap is on me.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, but we already moved our data export to April 18 based on that. I can’t have my team re-scoping this every week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. I talked to deal desk this morning and we’re adding a zero-dollar services amendment for the sandbox import, up to 12 hours, tied to the April 18 export. I’ll send that by 2:00 today, and I’ll also have the coordinator resend the project plan with it included.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Does that change the May 6 go-live?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No, May 6 still holds. The only dependency is you getting the CSV files and field list over by end of day April 18. If that slips past April 19, then we’d probably move go-live to May 8 or 9.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s fine. Also, the invoice we got shows quarterly billing starting April 1, but procurement approved annual prepay with net 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I saw that too. Billing used the default schedule. I’ve already asked them to reissue annual prepay, net 30, first invoice dated April 5 for $42,500 plus the $3,200 onboarding fee.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Send me the amendment and corrected invoice, and we’re good.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You’ll have the amendment first, then the corrected invoice once billing posts it. Thanks for being direct about it.
